name: Combo
description: After resolving the effects of an ability with Combo, you may use one of the specified abilities at any point during your turn. You may move before doing so, and may choose a new target when using this additional ability.

name: Oath Mastery
description: Certain effects grant you Conviction. You can have up to 4 Conviction at any given time. At the start of your turn, gain 1 Conviction.

name: Enhanced Enmity
description: Enemies that you have Enmity on incur a -8 penalty on all ability checks that do not target you.
